# Assignment 7 — the archer shot

Every strip below is a **fixture capture** from `godot/previews/shoot_preview.tscn`: the real background and
the real `archer.tscn`, with one scarecrow placed on a fixed tick so that `archer.gd`'s own rule starts the
draw on strip frame 10 (`--fixed-fps 30`, physics at 60). Strip frame 10+k shows clip frame k. Each strip's
per-frame log is `logs/shoot_preview_r<N>.log`, and capture file N matches the log line whose first field is
N. Verdicts are Rui's, made watching the preview windowed at 1280×720. Claude's readings are claims.

## 2026-11-22 — first look at r0 (before Claude reads anything)

What I saw (preview, windowed, at normal speed and at `--time-scale 0.25`), in Rui's words:

> 感觉拉弓的幅度有点小，在正常状态下难以看清三个阶段，箭出来的时机没问题

Translation (Claude, faithful): "The draw's movement feels a bit small; at normal speed the three phases are
hard to tell apart. The moment the arrow comes out is fine."

The keys under test are the agent's proposals from Step 4: at full draw (clip frame 8) the bow is at −8°,
pulled 1 px left and 3 px down, and the string is moved 3 px and stretched to 110 %; on release (clip frame 9)
there is a +2° kick.

- Strip: `captures/shoot/r0/` (fixture capture). Kept frames: 9 (idle, before the trigger), 10 (trigger,
  clip 0), 18 (full draw, clip 8, `release_window` true), 19 (arrow out, clip 9) and 25 (idle again). The
  other 85 frames were moved to `F:\7270\a7-captures\shoot-r0\`.
- Log: `logs/shoot_preview_r0.log`.
- Enlarged crop of the archer at those frames: `captures/shoot/sheets/r0_boundaries_x4.png`.

125:	_check(shoot_paths.size() >= 2, "shoot keys at least one rig transform (got %d tracks)" % shoot_paths.size())
126:
127:	# ---- shoot: transform tracks keyed at every phase boundary ----
128:	for t in shoot.get_track_count():
129:		var path := str(shoot.track_get_path(t))
130:		if path == RELEASE_PATH:
131:			continue
132:		_check(shoot.value_track_get_update_mode(t) == Animation.UPDATE_CONTINUOUS,
133:			"shoot %s is UPDATE_CONTINUOUS (got %d)" % [path, shoot.value_track_get_update_mode(t)])
134:		var n := shoot.track_get_key_count(t)
135:		_check(n == BOUNDARY_FRAMES.size(), "shoot %s has %d keys (got %d)" % [path, BOUNDARY_FRAMES.size(), n])
136:		for i in mini(n, BOUNDARY_FRAMES.size()):

138:			var kt := shoot.track_get_key_time(t, i)
139:			_check(absf(kt - want) < KEY_TOL,
140:				"shoot %s key %d at frame %d: %.8f within 1/60 of %.8f" % [path, i, BOUNDARY_FRAMES[i], kt, want])
141:		if n == BOUNDARY_FRAMES.size():
142:			# Startup accelerates into frame 8 (ease in, transition > 1); recovery settles into 15 (ease out, 0..1).
143:			_check(shoot.track_get_key_transition(t, 0) > 1.0,
144:				"shoot %s: frame 0 -> 8 eases in (transition %.3f > 1)" % [path, shoot.track_get_key_transition(t, 0)])
145:			var rec := shoot.track_get_key_transition(t, 2)
146:			_check(rec > 0.0 and rec < 1.0, "shoot %s: frame 9 -> 15 eases out (transition %.3f in 0..1)" % [path, rec])
147:			_check(not _approx(shoot.track_get_key_value(t, 1), shoot.track_get_key_value(t, 0)),
148:				"shoot %s: frame 8 differs from rest" % path)
149:
150:	# ---- shoot: release_window ----
151:	var rt := shoot.find_track(NodePath(RELEASE_PATH), Animation.TYPE_VALUE)
152:	_check(rt >= 0, "shoot has a value track on %s" % RELEASE_PATH)
153:	if rt >= 0:
154:		_check(shoot.value_track_get_update_mode(rt) == Animation.UPDATE_DISCRETE,
155:			"release_window track is UPDATE_DISCRETE (got %d)" % shoot.value_track_get_update_mode(rt))
156:		var n := shoot.track_get_key_count(rt)
157:		_check(n == RELEASE_FRAMES.size(), "release_window has %d keys (got %d)" % [RELEASE_FRAMES.size(), n])
158:		for i in mini(n, RELEASE_FRAMES.size()):
159:			var want: float = RELEASE_FRAMES[i] / FPS
160:			var kt := shoot.track_get_key_time(rt, i)
161:			var kv: Variant = shoot.track_get_key_value(rt, i)
162:			_check(absf(kt - want) < KEY_TOL,
163:				"release_window key %d at frame %d: %.8f within 1/60 of %.8f" % [i, RELEASE_FRAMES[i], kt, want])
164:			_check(typeof(kv) == TYPE_BOOL and kv == RELEASE_VALUES[i],
165:				"release_window key %d == %s (got %s)" % [i, RELEASE_VALUES[i], kv])
166:
167:	# ---- idle: one key at 0 per property, equal to shoot's frame 0 and frame 15 ----
168:	for t in idle.get_track_count():
169:		var path := idle.track_get_path(t)
170:		_check(idle.track_get_key_count(t) == 1 and absf(idle.track_get_key_time(t, 0)) < KEY_TOL,
171:			"idle %s has one key at 0 s" % path)
172:		var iv: Variant = idle.track_get_key_value(t, 0)
173:		var st := shoot.find_track(path, Animation.TYPE_VALUE)
174:		if st < 0 or shoot.track_get_key_count(st) == 0:
175:			continue
176:		_check(_approx(iv, shoot.track_get_key_value(st, 0)),
177:			"idle %s == shoot frame 0 (%s / %s)" % [path, iv, shoot.track_get_key_value(st, 0)])
178:		if str(path) == RELEASE_PATH:
179:			_check(idle.value_track_get_update_mode(t) == Animation.UPDATE_DISCRETE, "idle release_window is UPDATE_DISCRETE")
180:			_check(typeof(iv) == TYPE_BOOL and iv == false, "idle keys release_window false (got %s)" % iv)
181:			continue
182:		var last := shoot.track_get_key_count(st) - 1
183:		_check(absf(shoot.track_get_key_time(st, last) - shoot.length) < KEY_TOL,
184:			"shoot %s last key is at the clip end" % path)
185:		_check(_approx(iv, shoot.track_get_key_value(st, last)),
186:			"idle %s == shoot frame 15 (%s / %s)" % [path, iv, shoot.track_get_key_value(st, last)])
187:		# The scene's own rest values are the idle pose, so the rig sits at rest before anything plays.
188:		var node := anchor.get_node_or_null(NodePath(path.get_concatenated_names()))
189:		if node:
190:			var scene_v: Variant = node.get(path.get_concatenated_subnames())
191:			_check(_approx(iv, scene_v), "scene rest %s == idle (%s / %s)" % [path, scene_v, iv])
192:
193:	_print_pose_table(shoot)
194:	root.free()
195:	_finish()

## Where the motion and the phase table disagree

Scale matters here. The bow stave is 46 px tall with the grip at its centre, so each tip sits 23 px from the pivot. At −8° a tip moves sideways only 23·sin 8° ≈ 3 px. That's about one stave width at 1:1.

At normal speed the shot reads as roughly 0.13 s of idle-looking draw, a small lean, a snap, and then idle. That fits your note: the draw is small and the three phases run together.

**Change the `Rig/BowPivot:rotation` key at clip frame 8 from −8° to −16°** (`-0.13962634` → `-0.27925268`). Times, transitions, the +2° kick, the pivot, the string and `release_window` all stay as they are.

- **Why not more:** at −16° the stave's upper part crosses the hood's right edge by about 2–3 px, drawn over it. Going further would push it well into the head.
- **What it won't fix:** recovery (clip 9–14) will still look like idle, and clip 1–3 will still move under about 1 px. If the recapture shows that, the next single-change candidate is the +2° kick, the rotation key at clip frame 9.

- **Log:** `pivot_rot_deg` for clip 1–8 should read −0.25, −1.00, −2.25, −4.00, −6.25, −9.00, −12.25, **−16.00**. - **Strip 19:** a visible 18° snap back to almost upright, with the arrow out.

`godot/tests/test_archer_shot_readback.gd` pins no pose values.
